name: Fulvestrant
mechanism: Steroidal pure ER antagonist that impairs receptor dimerisation and nuclear localisation and accelerates ER degradation. Backbone partner for CDK4/6, PI3K-alpha and AKT inhibitors.
keyToxicities: Sciatic nerve-related symptoms from gluteal injection
monitoring: Caution with injections in patients with thrombocytopenia or on anticoagulants
resistance: Certain ESR1 mutations (e.g. Y537S) reduce sensitivity; limited bioavailability with intramuscular delivery may contribute to incomplete ER degradation.
